channel.title: IBM Corporation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by IBM Corporation (ibm).

item.title: CVE-2026-93905 · 8.2 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty is affected by a deserialization of untrusted data
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to corrupt the persisted status of batch job instances.

item.title: CVE-2026-93909 · 9.1 CRITICAL 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty is affected by an authentication bypass
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 is vulnerable by an authentication bypass vulnerability when samlWeb-2.0 feature is enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-93895 · 9.1 CRITICAL 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty Improper Access Control
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 20.0.0.12 through 26.0.0.10 could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass access controls configured on gRPC service methods.

item.title: CVE-2026-95695 · 7.4 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty Incorrect Authorization
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 20.0.0.12 through 26.0.0.10 could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions due to incorrect authorization.

item.title: CVE-2026-95696 · 6.5 MEDIUM 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty Denial of Service
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 20.0.0.12 through 26.0.0.10 could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to an uncaught exception.

item.title: CVE-2026-101294 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server and WebSphere Application Server Liberty are affected by a missing cryptographic step

item.title: CVE-2026-105442 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server and WebSphere Application Server Liberty are affected by a deserialization of untrusted data
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5, and 9.0 and IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 Liberty could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service caused by an insecure deserialization in the messaging service.

item.title: CVE-2026-105443 · 8.2 HIGH — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty is affected by an improper access control
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 has insufficient isolation between servers sharing an install.

item.title: CVE-2026-11713 · 5.4 MEDIUM — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty Incorrect Authorization
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.9 is affected by a privilege escalation vulnerability with the restConnector-2.0 feature enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-14532 · 4.3 MEDIUM — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty Integer Overflow
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.9 could allow a Reader-role attacker to obtain version information that causes an uncaught exception.

item.title: CVE-2026-14909 · 6.5 MEDIUM — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty Information Disclosure

item.title: CVE-2026-77816 · 6.5 MEDIUM 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty Improper Certificate Validation
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.9 administrative client could allow man-in-the-middle attacks. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to obtain sensitive information.

item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.9 could allow a local attacker to traverse directories on the system. An attacker could use a specially crafted application archive to write files outside the intended directory.
